messages:
Sarah P (Partnerships): quick sync — need final decisions on partner MDF split, HW credit pool for our APAC reseller, and marketplace launch timing. deadline: EOD Friday. spreadsheet here: https://tiny.redwood/partner-mdf :spiral_calendar: 
Alex G.: can do async. i'll add marketplace co-sell targets and partner uplift assumptions to the sheet (filter: marketplace). ping me if you want a walkthrough.
Jenna Ops: pulling last quarter numbers now, will paste a clean table in 10m.
Jenna Ops: ```
Partner | Tier | Last Q MDF | Req this Q | Notes
ACME SI | Platinum | $120k | $80k | integration milestone 2
CloudMart | Gold | $40k | $30k | marketplace promo slot
HWPartner | Strategic | $200k credits | 150 GPU credits | APAC focus
```
Tina F.: total committed budget available for partner ops this quarter is $420,000 + 200 GPU credits. need GL codes for any reclass. @Sarah P please confirm if we should earmark 30% for HW credits.
Sarah P (Partnerships): yes please earmark 30% GPU credits for APAC HW partner and 15% of cash MDF for marketplace promos. rest goes to SI enablement and co-marketing.
Danny S.: for SI integrations — we should tie MDF release to completion of the technical enablement checklist (3 items). otherwise we end up paying before deal velocity.
Michael P.: also flagging announcement timing: marketing wants a 3-week runway for joint PR and landing page. If we pay MDF earlier, partners might expect announcement sooner. Recommend aligning MDF tranche 1 with enablement, tranche 2 post announcement.
Alex G.: noted. i'll add tranche columns to the sheet and proposed dates.
Matt (Mktg): can someone confirm embargo window? we need assets by 03/15 to go live 04/05.
Sarah P (Partnerships): embargo ok. put 03/15 in the sheet as milestone. Jenna, can you add partner comms checklist?
Jenna Ops: added comms checklist + delivery owners. also added SI gate checklist link: https://tiny.redwood/si-gates
Tina F.: tagging accounting rules: MDF payouts require signed MSA + completion form. i'll attach template in the sheet.
Danny S.: approved on gating. can we add 'measurable KPI' line to the scorecard? e.g., # of joint pipeline opps, co-sell ARR.
Sarah P (Partnerships): yes — scorecard to include pipeline opps, joint demos, and integration completion. i'll draft metrics.
kanban-bot: Reminder: Partner Ops sync created for 1954321200 — agenda: MDF split decision, HW credit allocations, announcement runway.
Alex G.: :thumbsup: i updated the sheet with tranche dates and KPI placeholders.
Michael P.: i'm ok with tranche approach. one ask — ensure marketplace promo includes a tech spotlight (blog + demo).
Matt (Mktg): will own the tech spotlight. will coordinate with partner comms.
Sarah P (Partnerships): action items: (1) finance to earmark 30% GPU credits & GL codes (Tina), (2) Alex to finalize tranche schedule and KPI numbers, (3) Jenna to add comms checklist + SI gates, (4) Matt to draft announcement assets timeline. returning to this thread for sign-offs. :white_check_mark:
